title: Blake Corum Continues to Carve Out Role in Rams Offense
description: Los Angeles Rams running back Blake Corum remains a steady producer alongside Kyren Williams, as Williams held a slight lead in touches, 16 to 13, last week. While Williams continues to see the majority of the offensive snaps (58%), head coach Sean McVay has found ways to utilize his change-of-pace back. Corum has seen 12 or more carries in each of the last three games, but faces a stiff Seattle Seahawks defense in Week 11.  Corum should be considered a speculative add on the waiver wire this week, with exploitable defenses down the road.
